inputs: Evidence packets only: measured deviations, per-ID statistics and at most six sample frames. No labels, capture names or metadata.
scoring: true_type is the majority attack type of labeled frames inside the alert; alerts on unlabeled frames are false alarms and are excluded from accuracy.

rescore.method: Rebuilt packets with E0 (alert window, frame count, detector score and components); re-parsed saved raw replies and checked citations once. Citations naming window, frame_count, detector_score or detector_components (or a dotted sub-field of one) become E0; an uncited claim cites E0 only if every number in it matches an E0 value within 0.5% (at least 0.006). Any other invalid citation leaves the explanation ungrounded. No model calls.
